features.name: active_tenure_months
features.description: The number of months between the donor's first and last donation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a direct measure of the donor's active lifespan, allowing tree models to split on donor longevity independent of absolute dates.

features.name: donations_per_month_tenure
features.description: The average number of donations per month over the donor's entire tenure.
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes donation frequency by tenure, creating a continuous rate that helps trees identify consistently highly engaged donors.

features.name: recent_donor_indicator
features.description: Boolean indicator for donors who have donated within the last 6 months.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a hard boolean split for recent activity, which is a strong predictor in RFM models, saving the tree from learning this threshold.

features.name: frequent_donor_indicator
features.description: Boolean indicator for donors who have made 5 or more donations.
features.expected_model_benefit: Isolates donors with a proven track record of multiple donations, providing a clear categorical split for tree ensembles.

features.name: donations_per_active_month
features.description: The rate of donations calculated only over the months the donor was actively donating.
features.expected_model_benefit: Measures donation density during the period the donor was actually active, offering a refined engagement metric robust to long periods of recent inactivity.

features.name: single_donation_indicator
features.description: Boolean indicator flagging donors who have only donated exactly once.
features.expected_model_benefit: Explicitly flags one-time donors, allowing trees to easily separate them from repeat donors who exhibit different behavioral patterns.

features.name: recency_frequency_interaction
features.description: The product of recency and frequency, highlighting historically frequent donors who have not donated recently.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the non-linear relationship between recency and frequency; high values highlight historically frequent donors who are currently lapsing.

features.name: recency_to_tenure_ratio
features.description: The ratio of months since last donation to months since first donation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Expresses recency as a fraction of total tenure, helping trees identify donors who churned early versus those who remained active for most of their tenure.

features.name: expected_donations_shortfall
features.description: The estimated number of missed donations, assuming a standard eligibility cycle of one donation every 3 months.
features.expected_model_benefit: Quantifies missed donations assuming a standard 3-month eligibility cycle, providing a continuous measure of lapsing behavior.

features.name: donor_loyalty_index
features.description: Semantic assessment of donor loyalty based on frequency, recency, and time, categorizing into ordinal levels of commitment.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a holistic, ordinal categorization of donor commitment, allowing trees to split on high-level semantic groupings rather than raw RFM values.

features.name: attrition_risk_score
features.description: Semantic evaluation of the likelihood that the donor has permanently stopped donating, comparing their recency to their average donation interval.
features.expected_model_benefit: Synthesizes recency and historical frequency into a single risk probability, giving trees a direct feature to assess the likelihood of permanent dropout.

features.name: average_months_between_donations
features.description: The average number of months that elapsed between consecutive donations for repeat donors.
features.expected_model_benefit: Calculates the historical interval between donations, enabling trees to identify donors with regular, predictable patterns versus sporadic ones.
